WITH constructor_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    c.constructorId,
    c.nationality,
    COUNT(*) as record_count
  FROM constructorStandings cs
  JOIN constructors c ON cs.constructorId = c.constructorId
  GROUP BY c.constructorId, c.nationality
)
SELECT 
  cc.constructorId,
  cc.nationality,
  cc.record_count,
  cc.record_count - (SELECT AVG(record_count) FROM constructor_counts) as difference_from_average
FROM constructor_counts cc
WHERE cc.record_count > (SELECT AVG(record_count) FROM constructor_counts)
ORDER BY difference_from_average DESC
LIMIT 10
